guest.ask: Ask the person who shared it for a new one.
guest.endedWhy: Shared lists stop working after {{days}} days, or when the person who shared them ends the link.
guest.fullWhy: A link takes up to {{max}} guests.
guest.name: Guest
guest.nameHint: So the others can see who added what. You can leave it empty.
guest.tagline: Add what's missing and check things off. No account needed.

https.cookie: Signed in, but this browser didn't keep the session. Open Promus over HTTPS.
https.how: Signing in and offline use only work over HTTPS. Put HTTPS in front of the server, for example with a reverse proxy, and open its https:// address.

install.ios: To install: in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Then open Promus from the Home Screen and sign in again: the installed app keeps its own sign-in, apart from Safari's.
install.other: To install: open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

invite.intro: Whoever opens this link can join your household and share its lists. It works once, for 7 days.
invite.title: Invite someone

join.intro: Choose a username and password for yourself. The link works once.
join.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
join.tagline: Join to share their household's lists.
join.title: Join a household

list.emptyHint: Add the first item with Add or find below.

login.pendingOtherUser: Sync or sign in as {{username}} first
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later

phone.local: This is the server's own address, which your phone can't open. On your phone, use the server's https:// address.
phone.scan: Scan with your phone's camera to open Promus there.

settings.householdIntro: Everyone here shares all of the household's lists.

setup.codeHint: In the server log, for example: docker logs promus
setup.codeInvalid: That code doesn't match. Check the server log for the current code.
setup.intro: Create the first account. You can invite the rest of your household from Settings afterwards.
setup.phoneIntro: Open Promus on the phone you shop with.
setup.title: Set up Promus

share.intro: Anyone with this link can add, change and check off items on this list. They see nothing else of yours, and they don't need an account.
share.title: Share {{list}}

sync.tooLarge: Too many changes to send at once
